description: Hartford is an inspiring place to study and the perfect place to kick-start your career. You will have plenty of opportunities, with multiple Fortune 500 companies and growing start-ups nearby. Hartford is also known as "the insurance capital of the world" thanks to the many opportunities available in this sector.
